text: Problem: Sensor Characteristics = A linear sensor has a transfer function of 20 [mV/mm], and an output range of 0 to 1.5 V. What is its instrument span? = An 8-bit ADC has an input voltage range from 0 to 3.3 V. What is its resolution in mV? = If the ADC was sampling the above linear sensor, what is the minimum displacement it can discern? = If the linear sensor has a resolution of 0.5 mm, which device (sensor or ADC) is limiting the overall measurement accuracy?
